hero.title: The client doesn't wait. Neither do you.
hero.subtitle: The dispatch platform for taxi and transfer businesses where punctuality matters. Assign rides, track drivers in real time, and coordinate airport pickups.

problem.title: Dispatching with paper and phone costs you clients
problem.subtitle: For time-critical business clients, minutes decide. These four gaps make the difference.

items.title: No live arrival time
items.desc: The client doesn't know when the driver arrives — and calls instead of waiting.

items.title: Airport pickups are painful
items.desc: Name boards, phone tag, searching at the terminal. Expensive parking minutes.

items.title: Information is scattered
items.desc: Ride, client and driver data live in chats, notes and people's heads.

items.title: No reminders
items.desc: Missed pickups because nobody was reminded in time.

features.title: Everything for the on-time transfer
features.subtitle: From request to pickup — built for small and medium transport businesses.

primary.title: Manual dispatch
primary.desc: Pending requests at a glance, assign drivers in one click. Travel-time validation via Google, conflict detection included.

primary.title: Airport coordination
primary.desc: Real-time location sharing, geofence for optimal entry. Lower parking costs, faster meetups at the terminal.

primary.title: Live tracking & ETA
primary.desc: Driver position and arrival time live for the client. The client sees when the car is coming.

secondary.title: Tenant isolation
secondary.desc: Every company sees only its own data. Strict separation by CompanyId — secure and GDPR-compliant.

secondary.title: Reports & metrics
secondary.desc: Rides, revenue and distance driven at a glance. Visibility across the whole operation.

secondary.title: Emergency reassign
secondary.desc: Driver breaks down? One click suggests the nearest available driver and hands the ride over.

secondary.title: Schedule validation
secondary.desc: Shifts are checked against real travel time — the system won't let you book an impossible schedule.

secondary.title: GDPR & audit trail
secondary.desc: Consent management, data export and deletion requests. Every action logged with who, when and what.

spotlight.title: More than dispatch — an on-time operation
spotlight.subtitle: The features that set Dispax apart from generic taxi software and marketplace apps.

blocks.title: Predictive ETA monitoring
blocks.desc: A background monitor recalculates every assigned ride's arrival time every minute. When a pickup is at risk, the dispatcher is alerted 5+ minutes before the client would ever call.
bullets: Live ETA via routing API, recomputed each minute
At-risk alert when the time buffer drops below 5 minutes
Push + dashboard alert with nearest backup drivers

blocks.title: Airport coordination
blocks.desc: Geofence around the terminal, live location sharing both ways, and an optimal-entry calculator that keeps the car out of expensive parking until the client is actually at the exit.
bullets: Checkpoint chain from landed to meeting point
Two-way live location between driver and client
Optimal entry timing to cut parking costs

blocks.title: Billing & DATEV export
blocks.desc: Build invoices that auto-fill from completed rides, send them as PDF, and export everything in the format German tax accounting expects — no double entry.
bullets: DATEV-ready CSV export for rides and expenses

blocks.title: Ride pools & templates
blocks.desc: Group several rides onto one driver for shared airport runs, and automate recurring routes with daily, weekday or weekly recurrence — generated as real rides on demand.
bullets: Pool passengers onto a single optimised route
Recurring templates: daily, weekdays or weekly
Generate a batch of rides for any date range

privacy.collect: When you request a demo or join the waitlist through the form on this website, we process the email address you provide solely to respond to your request and to inform you about the availability of Dispax.
privacy.purpose: The legal basis for processing is Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR (consent) and (b) GDPR (steps prior to entering into a contract). Your data is not shared with third parties.
privacy.retention: We retain your data only for as long as necessary for the stated purposes or until you withdraw your consent.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection. You also have the right to withdraw consent at any time and to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To do so, contact hallo@dispax.de.
privacy.hosting: This website is hosted by a service provider that processes technically necessary data (e.g. IP address, time of access) in server log files to deliver the site. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure operation of the website).
